The board is leaning bear and sitting at setup, a couple short of the bar for action. In place: the breadth divergence at the highs and the haven filter confirming money is crowding into pure safety.

Missing: the credit stress leg, high-yield spreads widening or HYG rolling off its highs, which is what historically converts this configuration into a correction instead of a scare. Confluence over 8 weeks bear vs bull
Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. SKEW, the price this signal reads
The number this signal watches: level
SKEWlevelthe days it was truethreshold 140.00
Red on the lower chart marks every day this whole condition was true. Compare the shape of those episodes with where the line sits now.
AI read

SKEW is the price of out-of-the-money put protection, and when it jumps you know real money is paying up for crash insurance. SKEW at or above 140 is in place, but SKEW stretched (z20 at or above 1.5) is missing, so you have the level without the acceleration.

A fast push higher on the 20-day z would complete the pair and give you the version the lab actually validated. What would kill it: SKEW grinding sideways while equities keep bidding, which is where a lot of these spot-only reads die.

Kerberos said

"SKEW range 100-150, average 115. 140+ = deep OTM put demand, tail risk priced in. uncorrelated with VIX day to day."

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro. Grey rows are conditions Kerberos tracked that we cannot source yet; they stay listed so the catalog remains complete. Our own backtest verdicts live inside each row's detail.
